scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @talentlens/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api,worker --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @talentlens/shared && npm run build --workspace @talentlens/database && npm run build --workspace @talentlens/api && npm run build --workspace @talentlens/worker && npm run build --workspace @talentlens/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @talentlens/shared && npm run typecheck:tests --workspace @talentlens/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @talentlens/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @talentlens/api && npm run typecheck:tests --workspace @talentlens/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @talentlens/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @talentlens/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @talentlens/shared && npm run test --workspace @talentlens/shared && npm run test --workspace @talentlens/api
